mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/1f6f070ae4e2-t1/ws/prep_EC59; cat > /srv/leakruns/1f6f070ae4e2-t1/ws/prep_EC59/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_EC59 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 분할 배정만 만든다(학습·평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep_EC59"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_EC59.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
data_end = a["admit_time"].max()

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit > a.tp) & (a.next_admit <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_lt_30d"] = (data_end - a.tp) < pd.Timedelta(days=30)

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
flow = {"admissions": len(c)}
c = c[c.age >= 18]; flow["adult"] = len(c)
c = c[c.discharge_status != "died"]; flow["excl_died_in_hospital"] = len(c)
flow["of_which_followup_lt_30d_not_excluded"] = int(c.followup_lt_30d.sum())

# 특징
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 계산

# 진단: 시각 열이 없으므로 '해당 입원(index admission)'으로 한정 — 설계 확인 필요
dxa = dx.assign(chf=dx.icd_code.str.startswith("I50"), ckd=dx.icd_code.str.startswith("N18"))
dxa = dxa.groupby("admission_id").agg(n_dx=("seq", "size"), dx_chf=("chf", "any"), dx_ckd=("ckd", "any"))
c = c.merge(dxa, on="admission_id", how="left")
c[["n_dx"]] = c[["n_dx"]].fillna(0)
c[["dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]] = c[["dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]].fillna(False).astype(int)

def in_window(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m.admit_time) & (m[tcol] <= m.tp)]

dia = in_window(orders[orders.order_type == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(dia.admission_id).astype(int)

lw = in_window(labs, "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
cr = lw[lw.test == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id").value.last().rename("cr_last")
hgb = lw[lw.test == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id").value.min().rename("hgb_min")
c = c.merge(cr, on="admission_id", how="left").merge(hgb, on="admission_id", how="left")

# prior_cr_last: 같은 환자의 이전 입원들에서 report_time <= tp 인 마지막 크레아티닌
lc = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].merge(a[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
lc = lc.rename(columns={"admission_id": "src_adm", "admit_time": "src_admit"})
pr = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].merge(lc, on="patient_id")
pr = pr[(pr.src_admit < pr.admit_time) & (pr.report_time <= pr.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
c = c.merge(pr.groupby("admission_id").value.last().rename("prior_cr_last"), on="admission_id", how="left")

# 분할: family_id 결측이 많아 patient_id로 대체한 잠정 그룹 — 설계 확인 필요
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna("PAT_" + c.patient_id)
sp = design["split"]
groups = np.sort(c.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * sp["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "followup_lt_30d", "readmit_30d"] + feats
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "flow": flow,
    "n_rows": len(c), "readmit_rate": round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "readmit_by_discharge_status": c.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "readmit_by_unit": c.groupby("unit").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "missing_rate": c[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_rate_patients": round(p.family_id.isna().mean(), 4),
    "split_counts": c.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_readmit_rate": c.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits": int((c.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "labs_reported_after_discharge_excluded": int((labs.merge(a, on="admission_id").eval("report_time > discharge_time")).sum()),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
